_instructions: Filled by site-analyst from the site's Certificado de Informaciones Previas
and the PRC ordenanza. tools/norm_check.py READS THIS FILE, so a wrong value
here produces a wrong compliance verdict.
Leave a value null when you do not have a source for it. A null makes the
dependent rule report SKIP or UNVERIFIED, which is correct. A guessed value
makes it report PASS, which is a fabricated verdict.
Never copy prc_limits from another project: they vary by comuna AND by zone

prc_limits._note: Numeric ceilings from the PRC. occupancy_ratio and far feed norm_check.py directly.

prm._note: Metropolitan/intercommunal plan layered over the PRC (Gran Concepcion: PRMC). Sets risk areas, including tsunami flooding. See docs/region_concepcion.md.

_ppda_note: Atmospheric decontamination plan in force in the comuna, if any. Write exactly "Concepcion Metropolitano" when the comuna is in that PPDA (DS N°6/2018 MMA), confirmed against the decree: it enables rule PPDA-CM-vivienda-nueva-U in norm_check.py. null = not declared.
_rainfall_note: Intensidad de lluvia de diseño (mm/h) de la comuna para el período de retorno que exija la norma de aguas lluvias (RIDAA, DS 50/2002 MOP; sin transcribir). null = tools/aguas_lluvias.py informa INCONCLUSO.
_thermal_zone_note: Thermal zone A-I of the comuna per OGUC Art. 4.1.10 as replaced by DS N°15/2024 MINVU (previously 7 zones). Selects the entire U-value limit table; without it no thermal verdict is possible.

seismic._note: NCh 433 seismic zone (Table 4.1, by comuna) and soil class per DS N°61/2011 MINVU (Vs30 plus complementary tests). Soil class comes from a geotechnical study of the site, never from a map or a neighbouring lot.

risk_designations._note: In Gran Concepcion read the PRMC risk plan at the parcel (tsunami high/medium, flooding, landslide, wildfire). Each value cites the plan sheet as its source.
